findings.statement: not writing the index slack is worth measuring on a bulk load
findings.detail: 1127944 ops/s leaving the slack a hole against 973803 writing it (hole vs written: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 1.158, p=0.0553) -- within noise, not a result)

findings.statement: the two arms produce the same file size
findings.detail: 176681680 bytes against 176681680 bytes, with 157949952 against 175951872 sent to the device. The apparent size is identical because the slack is reserved either way; the difference is a hole, which file size cannot see and /proc/self/io can

notes: both arms interleaved in one process; the only difference is Options::write_index_slack
